review_scope: Read-only review of the separately authored installed P09 auditor and current CLI/authority contracts before actual-source freeze.
contract_checks: No producer policy_v1, baseline_v1 or controls_v1 imports, old dynamic tool imports, compiler calls or scorer calls inside the auditor.
Fresh expected native facts are derived directly from complete originals, independently reconstructed tasks and literal one-to-many locus joins.

The production entry requires the exact 137-file family frame: 100 GWAS, 25 credible-set, 10 target, one disease and one HGNC original, with ordered unique logical paths and exact payload/receipt bytes.
Receipt-only Windows separator normalization preserves strict identity; fresh receipt dates, flat original ancestry, role catalog and InputGraph admission precede value scans.

Full schemas, Parquet footers, row groups, physical row counts, all canonical mapping rows and every selected-locus physical match are scanned; date, annotation, exposure and mapping exclusions are retained.
Tasks, complete eligible/excluded inventories, normalization proofs, source coverage and all genuine compiled native-reference fields are checked against independent projections.
Historical reference projection removes only method.catalog_sha256. Source snapshot, task, facts, source proofs, joins and all other fields remain bound.
All 38 ordered unique raw outputs, 90 decisions, G0-G4 records, genuine core-score serialization, strict exactness, unknown accounting and descriptive counts are independently checked.
Constructed control sources and malformed candidate bytes are independently authored and checked; expected labels do not assign guard outcomes.

External protocol bytes, exact READY authorization, environment, complete installed code/resource inventories, bundle descriptors, whole final receipt inventory, precomparison seal inventory and journal ordering are checked.

Stable original handles span independent native projection and comparison; cleanup exceptions occur before PASS assignment. The auditor writes no artifacts; CLI transaction tests cover failure/interruption receipt behavior.

findings.problem: A rechained and resealed journal could omit or contradict the terminal report SHA and authorized comparison SHA.
findings.resolution: _journal_and_receipt now requires reconstruction_completed.details.report_sha256 to equal exact retained report bytes and comparison_started.details.comparison_sha256 to equal the externally authorized comparator descriptor.
findings.regression: Changed and missing report/comparator bindings fail after journal rechain and receipt reseal.

findings.problem: Matching artifact hashes did not reject contradictory schema, scientific-validation, model/activity or historical-archive scope claims.
findings.resolution: Receipt, seal and report require integer schema version 1; canonical typed comparisons enforce the existing no-model/no-network/no-download/no-spending and not-established scientific scope, precomparison flag, exact all-38/all-90 comparison claim and explicit absence of original private-archive integrity.
findings.regression: Resealed schema booleans and contradictory scope flags fail.

findings.problem: Historical decision rows were compared only over supplied keys, permitting empty rows; extra historical guard IDs were ignored, and Python numeric equality allowed boolean/float denominator substitutions.
findings.resolution: Bridge decisions now require the exact exported field set and canonical equality; guards require exactly the 38 scheduled IDs; all native historical denominator values use canonical typed equality.
findings.regression: Empty, missing-field or extra-field decisions, extra guard IDs, and True/1.0 count substitutions fail.

test_evidence.phase: independent full synthetic run before narrow peer corrections
test_evidence.subject: initial_subject
test_evidence.includes: Real Windows stable paths and locks; invented 137-original Parquet/TSV frame; all 38 outputs/90 decisions; genuine core reference/scoring comparisons; resealed score-tamper failure.

test_evidence.subject: final_subject
test_evidence.includes: Real transaction files, exact byte hashes, resealed/rechained tampering, authority denials, complete typed bridge and failure cases.

test_environment: Workspace .venv; workspace TEMP/TMP; explicit development PYTHONPATH for src and release/code/src, plus test path for focused classes. This is not installed-wheel qualification.
test_limits: The full 137-file synthetic test passed at initial pins. Its final metadata migration was read and found consistent with the current CLI; the full long test was not repeated after the bounded metadata-only corrections. Final changed-contract classes were independently rerun.

author_failing_before_evidence.reported_result: 12 tests exposed 28 false-accept subfailures before the fixes.

independence_and_limits: Auditor expected facts and decisions are independent of producer modules. Core contracts, provenance, canonical serialization, field taxonomy, stable reads and the Windows/Python/Arrow environment remain shared software dependencies.

The peer reviewer previously implemented the separate P09 producer policy and baseline modules; this is a review of a different author's auditor, not a blinded independent study or an actual-source audit.
New public G0 authority does not attest the original private journals or full private archive. Exact historical-output reconstruction and optional original-archive verification remain distinct.
Trusted local installed code and operating-system behavior remain assumptions; no hostile-host sandbox guarantee is made.
Actual installed reconstruction and independent source-inclusive auditing remain separate later gates. Scientific, biological and clinical validation are not established.
